title: d1-omni Inbox
what: The d1-omni inbox demo: three unread items (a voice note, a photo, a message) and typed questions about each; every item's questions are answered on the phone in one pass of the model per question. Only invented names; the media are the model repository's public check-set files.

media.licence: speech synthesised with Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0) from a script written for the check set
